messages.content: Each section must begin with a thesis statement in italics, use HTML to indicate the italics. Write a story about a hedgehog with glasses, the only real creature in an abstract world, resembling abstract art

message.content: The hedgehog with glasses was the only real creature in a world made of shapes. The world was made of blue squares, red circles, and yellow triangles. There were no edges or boundaries. There were no lines between them. The hedgehog walked through this world, and his glasses helped him see the colors. The hedgehog found that the world was changing for the better. The world became more colorful when the hedgehog walked through it. The blue squares turned into flowers, and the red circles turned into fruits. The hedgehog's steps made the world more alive. The hedgehog knew that he had to keep the world in focus. The hedgehog sat on a blue square, and his glasses reflected the colors of the world. The blue squares became a sky, and the red circles became a sun. Only the hedgehog could make the world real. The hedgehog slept, and his dreams made the world real. The blue squares became a forest, and the red circles became a sea. The hedgehog's glasses reflected the light of the world.
